pillar: Personal update: job search and portfolio
text:
Most people treat hackathons as a resume line rather than a real test.

We usually rush to build something massive instead of focusing on a single working feature. It is far better to narrow the scope early and finish one problem completely. Judges and teams care much more about execution than an unfinished vision. When you keep the goal simple, the actual building becomes much easier to manage.

What is your preferred approach when building under a tight deadline?
